checklist: The one- or two-line idea the chat and every later decision build on.
Who the reader follows; scenes and knowledge are written from their point of view.
What or who pushes back, so chapters have something to write against.
What the book is about underneath the plot.
What the reader is waiting for and expects to be paid off.
How the book ends. Planner-only — never shown to the reader early — and fine to leave undecided for now.
What changes by the end of volume one.
A short plan for the next chapter, agreed with the chat before it is written.
